bio_en: Tadevos Tadevosian was born on 21 September 1881 (Old Style) and studied in Kanaker, at the Yerevan diocesan school and at the Petrograd agricultural institute. He joined the ARF in 1900, helped organise the Yerevan demonstration against the 1903 church-property seizure, fought in the Armenian-Tatar clashes and carried arms. In 1915 he served in Ishkhan's and then Dro's volunteer regiments, and from 1916 guarded the volunteers' secret ammunition stores; in 1917-20 he was commissar of the first district of Yerevan uezd. In emigration he lived in Iran, mainly New Julfa, where he died on 7 April 1975.
